senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. לפף)to twine around, cling to, clasp.
units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:1">Ruth R. to III, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00646"><he>לָפַף</he></cite>; Tanḥ. B’har 3 (expl. <he>וילפת</he>, Ruth l. c. ‘he felt himself embraced’) <he>כמו דאמרת ויִלְפֹּת וכ׳</he> as you read (<cite ref="Judges 16:29">Jud. XVI, 29</cite>) and Samson clasped &c.

senses.gloss: (cmp. כָּרַךְ) to wrap up, to insert, combine (dishes).—Part. pass. לָפוּת, pl. לְפוּתִין.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:7:2">Koh. R. to VII, 7</cite> (expl. <cite ref="L00656"><he>לִפְתָּן</he></cite>) <he>שני תבשילין ל׳ זה בזה</he> two messes combined.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38a">Ab. Zar. 38ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 59a:10">59ᵃ</cite> <he>לְלַפֵּת בו את הפת</he> to go with bread as a relish.
